hardRules: Preserve `artist_music` as the canonical upload/catalog row and preserve private `artist-music` storage, signed streaming, `resolveMusicAccess`, Jukebox, mobile, feed, profile, EPK, marketplace and analytics paths.
Never reset or destructively rewrite the database; use additive migrations, explicit backfills, versioned records, feature flags, append-only audit/outbox events and compensating actions.
Tourify remains an optional provider; renewal, archives, public services, succession and wind-down must remain independently operable.
No Phase 18 capability ships under Phase 17 flags and no Phase 18 authority is inferred from Phase 17 participation.
No institution, protocol, service, mandate, privilege, membership or governance power is perpetual by software default.
No account, identifier, credential, observer role, advisory seat, historic membership or public projection creates current authority.
The current instrument, participant authority, governing-body decision, jurisdiction, mandate, reservation, host arrangement and source record control each high-impact action.

Identifiers and credentials are references and signed statements; they do not create copyright ownership, licensing, administration, collection, payment, enforcement, diplomatic or representation authority.
Local creator and organization sovereignty, exit, reserved powers and provider portability remain protected across generations.
Future-generation participation is advisory or governance-scoped only as lawfully constituted; it cannot invent absent authority.
Public projections expose only approved minimal data and are never the sole authorization source for a high-impact action.
Historical actions retain their original policy, schema, jurisdiction, effective period, evidence and audit context.
Renewal requires affirmative evidence, lawful approval, public notice and a new effective period; silence never renews authority.
Sunset, suspension, termination, dissolution and archival survival are separate workflows with tested continuity and remedy.
No coordinated pricing, collective bargaining, collective licensing, representation, enforcement, boycott or market allocation is created through Phase 18.
Missing legal authority, repeated-cycle evidence, archive custody, funding, oversight, staffing, provider contracts, privacy, security, accessibility, competition or public approval is a blocker.
